Name: WF_BazaCalculBrut_Generare
Description:
Genereaza si recalculeaza snapshot-ul lunar al veniturilor brute payroll pe baza:
- Salariat
- ExceptiiPrezenta
- NomFunctie
- NomGrilaSalarizare
- Agent
- Remiza
- AltDrept
- Diurna

Workflow-ul construieste:
- brut lucrat
- sporuri
- indemnizatii
- venituri suplimentare
- baze contributive
- baze impozabile
- brut total payroll

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
DELETE FROM app.BazaCalculBrut
WHERE Luna = @Luna
  AND Anul = @Anul
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Name: EventType
ActionParameters.Value: ADMIN_ALERT

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
;WITH Parametri AS
(
    SELECT
        [Initializari:ZileLucratoare_old(
            Anul = [GetOrSession:YearV],
            Luna = [GetOrSession:MonthV]
        )] AS ZileLucratoare
),

-------------------------------------------------
-- TICHETE DE MASA CALCULATE
-------------------------------------------------
TicheteMasa AS
(
    SELECT
        tm.Marca,
        tm.CodSucursala,
        tm.Anul,
        tm.Luna,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- NUMARUL FINAL DE TICHETE
        --
        -- NrTMTotal include corectiile si tichetele
        -- necuvenite.
        -------------------------------------------------
        MAX
        (
            ISNULL(tm.NrTMTotal, 0)
        ) AS NumarTicheteMasa,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- SUMA FINALA A TICHETELOR
        --
        -- SumaTicheteMasa =
        -- NrTMTotal * ValoareTichet
        -------------------------------------------------
        MAX
        (
            ISNULL(tm.SumaTicheteMasa, 0)
        ) AS ValoareTicheteMasa

    FROM app.TichetMasa tm

    WHERE tm.Luna = @Luna
      AND tm.Anul = @Anul
      AND tm.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      -------------------------------------------------
      -- 1 = DRAFT
      --
      -- După introducerea confirmării, această condiție
      -- va deveni:
      -- AND tm.Status = 2
      -------------------------------------------------
      AND tm.Status = 2

    GROUP BY
        tm.Marca,
        tm.CodSucursala,
        tm.Anul,
        tm.Luna
)


-------------------------------------------------
-- INSERT BAZA CALCUL BRUT
-------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO app.BazaCalculBrut
(
    Marca,
    CodSucursala,
    Judet,
    Luna,
    Anul,

    Clasa,
    SalarBaza,
    TipNorma,

    TarifOrar,
    ZileLucratoare,
    ZileLucrate,
    OrePrezentaEfectiva,

    NumarTicheteMasa,
    ValoareTicheteMasa,

    BrutLucrat,
    BrutCO,
    BrutCM,
    BrutSomajTehnic,
    BrutLiberePlatite,

    BrutOreSup50,
    BrutOreSup100,
    BrutOreSuplimentare,

    BrutNoapte,
    BrutSambataDuminica,
    BrutGaraj,
    BrutAdministrativ,
    BrutIntrajudetene,

    BrutOreAditionale,

    BrutConducere,
    BrutLoialitate,
    BrutNocivitate,
    BrutContinuitate,
    BrutCFP,
    BrutProiect,
    BrutProgramFractionat,

    BrutIndemnizatiiFixe,
    BrutIndemnizatiiProc,

    BrutAgenti,
    BrutRemize,
    BrutBonusuri,

    BrutAlteDrepturi,
    BrutAlteDrepturiImpozabile,
    BrutAlteDrepturiNeimpozabile,

    BrutDelegatieImpozabila,
    BrutDelegatieNeimpozabila,

    BrutVenituriSuplimentare,

    BrutContributiv,
    BrutImpozabil,
    BrutTotal,

    EsteProcesat,
    Status,

    CreatedBy,
    CreatedDate,
    LastModifiedBy,
    LastModifiedDate,

    MesajValidare
)

SELECT

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- IDENTIFICARE
    -------------------------------------------------
    s.Marca
        AS Marca,

    s.CodSucursala
        AS CodSucursala,

    s.Judet
        AS Judet,

    s.Luna
        AS Luna,

    s.Anul
        AS Anul,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- SNAPSHOT SALARIAL
    -------------------------------------------------
    s.Clasa
        AS Clasa,

    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0),
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS SalarBaza,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- TIP NORMA
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ISNULL
        (
            ep.TipNorma,
            ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS TipNorma,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- TARIF ORAR
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            (
                ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
                *
                ISNULL
                (
                    ep.TipNorma,
                    ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
                *
                ISNULL
                (
                    ep.TipNorma,
                    ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                )
                *
                8,
                0
            ),
            4
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,4)
    ) AS TarifOrar,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- ZILE LUCRATOARE
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
        AS INT
    ) AS ZileLucratoare,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- ZILE LUCRATE EFECTIV PENTRU CALCUL BRUT
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        pr.ZileLucrateCalc
        AS INT
    ) AS ZileLucrate,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- ORE PREZENTA EFECTIVA
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        pr.OreLucrateCalc
        AS INT
    ) AS OrePrezentaEfectiva,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- NUMAR FINAL TICHETE MASA
    --
    -- Corectat:
    -- se folosește aliasul NumarTicheteMasa
    -- definit în CTE-ul TicheteMasa.
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ISNULL(tm.NumarTicheteMasa, 0)
        AS INT
    ) AS NumarTicheteMasa,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- VALOARE TOTALA TICHETE MASA
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            ISNULL(tm.ValoareTicheteMasa, 0),
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS ValoareTicheteMasa,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUT LUCRAT
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            (
                ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
                *
                ISNULL
                (
                    ep.TipNorma,
                    ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF
            (
                pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
                *
                ISNULL
                (
                    ep.TipNorma,
                    ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                )
                *
                8,
                0
            )
            *
            pr.OreLucrateCalc,
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS BrutLucrat,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUTURI INITIALE
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutCO,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutCM,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutSomajTehnic,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutLiberePlatite,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutOreSup50,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutOreSup100,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutOreSuplimentare,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutNoapte,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutSambataDuminica,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutGaraj,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutAdministrativ,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutIntrajudetene,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutOreAditionale,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutConducere,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutLoialitate,
        
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
    AS BrutNocivitate,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutContinuitate,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutCFP,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutProiect,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutProgramFractionat,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutIndemnizatiiFixe,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutIndemnizatiiProc,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutAgenti,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutRemize,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutBonusuri,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutAlteDrepturi,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutAlteDrepturiImpozabile,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutAlteDrepturiNeimpozabile,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutDelegatieImpozabila,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutDelegatieNeimpozabila,

    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        AS BrutVenituriSuplimentare,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUT CONTRIBUTIV INITIAL
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            (
                (
                    ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                )
                /
                NULLIF
                (
                    pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                    *
                    8,
                    0
                )
            )
            *
            pr.OreLucrateCalc,
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS BrutContributiv,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUT IMPOZABIL INITIAL
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            (
                (
                    ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                )
                /
                NULLIF
                (
                    pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                    *
                    8,
                    0
                )
            )
            *
            pr.OreLucrateCalc,
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS BrutImpozabil,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUT TOTAL INITIAL
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST
    (
        ROUND
        (
            (
                (
                    ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                )
                /
                NULLIF
                (
                    pr.ZileLucratoareCalc
                    *
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        ep.TipNorma,
                        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                    )
                    *
                    8,
                    0
                )
            )
            *
            pr.OreLucrateCalc,
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS BrutTotal,


    -------------------------------------------------
    -- AUDIT SI STATUS
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST(0 AS INT)
        AS EsteProcesat,

    CAST(1 AS INT)
        AS Status,

    NULL
        AS CreatedBy,

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()
        AS CreatedDate,

    NULL
        AS LastModifiedBy,

    NULL
        AS LastModifiedDate,

    NULL
        AS MesajValidare


FROM app.Salariat s

CROSS JOIN Parametri p


-------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTII PREZENTA
-------------------------------------------------
LEFT JOIN app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep
    ON ep.Marca = s.Marca
   AND ep.Luna = s.Luna
   AND ep.Anul = s.Anul
   AND ep.CodSucursala = s.CodSucursala


-------------------------------------------------
-- CALCUL ZILE SI ORE
-------------------------------------------------
CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- ZILE LUCRATOARE
        -------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ep.Id IS NULL
            THEN ISNULL(p.ZileLucratoare, 0)

            ELSE ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare, 0)

        END AS ZileLucratoareCalc,


        -------------------------------------------------
        -- ZILE LUCRATE PENTRU CALCUL BRUT
        --
        -- Include:
        --   zile lucrate efectiv
        --   norma 1/2
        --   program redus
        --   delegatii
        --   zile libere platite
        --   zile libere platite pentru ingrijire
        -------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ep.Id IS NULL
            THEN ISNULL(p.ZileLucratoare, 0)

            ELSE
                  ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrate, 0)
                + ISNULL(ep.Zile12Norma, 0)
                + ISNULL(ep.ZileProgramRedus, 0)
                + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie, 0)
                + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite, 0)
                

        END AS ZileLucrateCalc,


        -------------------------------------------------
        -- ORE LUCRATE PENTRU CALCUL BRUT
        -------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ep.Id IS NULL
            THEN
                ISNULL(p.ZileLucratoare, 0)
                *
                ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                *
                8

            ELSE
                (
                      ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrate, 0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.Zile12Norma, 0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileProgramRedus, 0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie, 0)
                    + ISNULL(ep.ZileLiberePlatite, 0)
                    
                )
                *
                ISNULL
                (
                    ep.TipNorma,
                    ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 1)
                )
                *
                8

        END AS OreLucrateCalc

) pr

-------------------------------------------------
-- TICHETE DE MASA CALCULATE
-------------------------------------------------
LEFT JOIN TicheteMasa tm
    ON tm.Marca = s.Marca
   AND tm.CodSucursala = s.CodSucursala
   AND tm.Luna = s.Luna
   AND tm.Anul = s.Anul


-------------------------------------------------
-- NOMENCLATOR FUNCTII
-------------------------------------------------
INNER JOIN app.NomFunctie nf
    ON nf.CodFunctie = s.CodFunctie
   AND nf.Luna = s.Luna
   AND nf.Anul = s.Anul
   AND nf.CodSucursala = s.CodSucursala


-------------------------------------------------
-- GRILA SALARIZARE
-------------------------------------------------
INNER JOIN app.NomGrilaSalarizare ngs
    ON ngs.Clasa = s.Clasa
   AND ngs.TipMediu = nf.TipMediu


-------------------------------------------------
-- FILTRE PERIOADA SI SUCURSALA
-------------------------------------------------
WHERE s.Luna = @Luna
  AND s.Anul = @Anul
  AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bcb
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- BRUT CO
    --
    -- CO efectuat
    -- +
    -- Loialitate CO
    -- +
    -- CO compensat
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutCO =

        CAST
        (
            -------------------------------------------------
            -- 1. SALARIU CO EFECTUAT
            -------------------------------------------------
            ISNULL
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ep.Id IS NOT NULL
                     AND ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare,0) > 0
                    THEN
                        ROUND
                        (
                            ISNULL(bcb.SalarBaza,0)

                            /

                            NULLIF
                            (
                                ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare,0),
                                0
                            )

                            *

                            ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)

                            *

                            ISNULL(bcb.TipNorma,1)

                        ,0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ,0)

            +

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- 2. LOIALITATE AFERENTA CO
            -------------------------------------------------
            ISNULL
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ep.Id IS NOT NULL
                     AND ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare,0) > 0
                    THEN
                        ROUND
                        (
                            ROUND
                            (
                                ISNULL(bcb.SalarBaza,0)

                                /

                                NULLIF
                                (
                                    ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare,0),
                                    0
                                )

                                *

                                ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0)

                                *

                                ISNULL(bcb.TipNorma,1)

                            ,0)

                            *

                            ISNULL(s.ProcentLoialitate,0)

                        ,0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ,0)

            +

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- 3. CO COMPENSAT
            -------------------------------------------------
            ISNULL(coc.SumaCOCompensat,0)

            AS DECIMAL(18,2)
        ),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- AUDIT
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bcb.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaCalculBrut bcb


-------------------------------------------------
-- EXCEPTII PREZENTA
--
-- LEFT JOIN:
-- CO compensat poate exista fara ExceptiiPrezenta
-------------------------------------------------
LEFT JOIN app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep
    ON ep.Marca = bcb.Marca
   AND ep.Luna = bcb.Luna
   AND ep.Anul = bcb.Anul
   AND ep.CodSucursala = bcb.CodSucursala


-------------------------------------------------
-- SALARIAT
-------------------------------------------------
INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON s.Marca = bcb.Marca
   AND s.Luna = bcb.Luna
   AND s.Anul = bcb.Anul
   AND s.CodSucursala = bcb.CodSucursala


-------------------------------------------------
-- CO COMPENSAT
-------------------------------------------------
OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT

        SUM
        (
            ISNULL(c.Suma,0)
        ) AS SumaCOCompensat

    FROM app.ConcediudeOdihnaCompensare c

    WHERE c.Marca = bcb.Marca
      AND c.CodSucursala = bcb.CodSucursala
      AND c.Luna = bcb.Luna
      AND c.Anul = bcb.Anul

) coc


-------------------------------------------------
-- PERIOADA
-------------------------------------------------
WHERE bcb.Luna = @Luna
  AND bcb.Anul = @Anul
  AND bcb.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
UPDATE bcb
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- CM total
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutCM =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0)

        + ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0)

        + ISNULL(cm.SumaPldinFondAcc,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- CM suportat unitate
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutCMUnitate =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- CM FNUASS
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutCMFNUASS =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- CM accidente
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutCMAccidente =

        ISNULL(cm.SumaPldinFondAcc,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BazaCM =

        ISNULL(cm.Bazacalcindem,0),

    bcb.MediaZilnicaCM =

        ISNULL(cm.MedZiBazaCalcul,0),

    bcb.ProcentCM =

        ISNULL(cm.ProcentCM,0),

    bcb.TipCM =

        cm.Codindemn,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bcb.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaCalculBrut bcb

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT

        cm.Marca,
        cm.Luna,
        cm.Anul,
        cm.CodSucursala,

        SUM(ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0))            AS SumaUnitate,

        SUM(ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0))      AS SumaPlatitadinCAS,

        SUM(ISNULL(cm.SumaPldinFondAcc,0))       AS SumaPldinFondAcc,

        MAX(ISNULL(cm.Bazacalcindem,0))          AS Bazacalcindem,

        MAX(ISNULL(cm.MedZiBazaCalcul,0))        AS MedZiBazaCalcul,

        MAX(ISNULL(cm.ProcentCM,0))              AS ProcentCM,

        MAX(cm.Codindemn)                        AS Codindemn

    FROM app.ConcediuMedical cm

    GROUP BY
        cm.Marca,
        cm.Luna,
        cm.Anul,
        cm.CodSucursala

) cm

    ON cm.Marca = bcb.Marca
   AND cm.Luna = bcb.Luna
   AND cm.Anul = bcb.Anul
   AND cm.CodSucursala = bcb.CodSucursala

WHERE bcb.Luna = @Luna
  AND bcb.Anul = @Anul
  AND bcb.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    bcb.BrutOreSup50 =

/*=====================================================
    Calcul Brut Ore de Noapte
    Spor = 25%
    Rotunjire la leu
=====================================================*/

UPDATE bcb
SET
    bcb.BrutNoapte =
        ROUND
        (
            ISNULL(bcb.TarifOrar, 0)
            *
            ISNULL(ep.OreNoapte, 0)
            *
            CAST(0.25 AS DECIMAL(18,4)),
            0
        ),

    bcb.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    bcb.EsteProcesat = 0

FROM app.BazaCalculBrut bcb

    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutConducere =

UPDATE bcb

    -------------------------------------------------

    --

    -- sf = sal1 * pf * (orel + ogar * 3/4) / ol1
    -------------------------------------------------
    bcb.BrutLoialitate =
